CustomField.description: When checked, data masking runs on each insert and update of this object, before its trigger actions. Needs the MaskingFramework_Enabled flag. Checked by default. With two or more settings for one object, masking is skipped only if all are unchecked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Masks the configured fields on this object before each insert and update. If the object has more than one trigger setting, masking is skipped only when all of them have this unchecked. Uncheck it only when the object holds no sensitive data and you want to save the time the masking step takes.
CustomField.label: Apply Masking
